title: Steps
description: Array of step records. All steps across all phases. The state machine counts entries with status='pending' for the current phase. Lives at .state/steps.json.

step.description: Step number within the phase. (phase, step) is the natural key.

status.description: Step status. Binary: pending = not yet completed; complete = work done and committed. Replaces e2e checkbox parsing — catches the 'missing checkbox' bug class by construction.

commit.description: Git commit hash for this step's work, if applicable. 4-40 hex chars (allows short hashes).

notes.description: Free-form notes about the step (intent, constraints, links).
